subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the google-vertex provider now that Google presents Vertex AI under Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: The source confirms stale visible copy, but the requested wording differs from current Google Cloud wording and a broad provider rename would affect compatibility-sensitive IDs.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only display labels and docs to bridge the new Google branding with the familiar Vertex AI name while keeping google-vertex stable.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Match the reporter’s requested wording, accepting that it is less directly supported by the checked Google Cloud docs.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave current copy in place until maintainers decide OpenClaw should follow the new Google branding.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update only display labels and docs to bridge the new Google branding with the familiar Vertex AI name while keeping google-vertex stable.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the strongest recent Google provider onboarding history and was already asked in the issue thread to make the label decision.
